# E2E scenario map

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/testing/scenarios.mjs - do not edit by hand. Run `npm run docs:scenarios`. -->

Every row is a Playwright scenario (or a recorded gap). IDs are stable: reference them in test titles, commits and bug reports.
Status: **covered** (test exists and passes), **fixme + bug** (test written, `test.fixme()` because of a product bug described in the note), **not covered** (to do), **n/a** (the product has nothing to test yet).

`@smoke` rows are the subset run by `npm run test:e2e:smoke`.
